title: AI tools to use in 2026
description: Don't use bad AI tools. Use these good ones instead.
transcript: For writing, don't use ChatGPT, use Claude. For research, don't use Google search, use Grok. For presentations, don't use Canva, use Gamma. To build apps, stop using Replit, use Claude Code. To generate images, you're crazy [snorts] if you're using ChatGPT, use Nano Banana. To prompt AI, stop typing on your keyboard, start using WhisperFlow. For agentic automation, stop using make.com or n8n, start using Open Claw. And if you want my version of it, go check out apex.host is my new company that makes Open Claw really simple to deploy. It's not about having more tools, it's about having the right tool for the right job.
